summary: The following fixes and features are available on the stable channel: Features & Improvements Added Brand Context , allowing the AI Assistant to follow your brand identity, visual style, and tone. Brand Context can be configured at runtime
body_markdown:
The following fixes and features are available on the[stable](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/version-management#production-environment) channel:


## Features & Improvements


-


Added[Brand Context](https://docs.unlayer.com/ai/assistant/customization/brand-guidelines) , allowing the AI Assistant to follow your brand identity, visual style, and tone. Brand Context can be configured at runtime or managed in Console, including importing a public website to create a draft.


-


Improved[AI Assistant](https://docs.unlayer.com/ai/assistant) performance, efficiency, and generation reliability, including automatic fallbacks and per-request AI Credit usage details. Also fixed validation failures with legacy designs and improved failure diagnostics.


-


Added a live AI Credits balance to the AI Assistant and introduced[in-builder credit upsell](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/credit-upsell) , allowing you to show host-managed per-user balances and connect your own purchase flow.


-


Upgraded[Inbox Previews](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/email-builder/inbox-previews) with updated email-client selection, project-level defaults, per-client usage, and clearer access and limit states. Editors using a version before 1.479.0 will automatically migrate to the new Inbox Previews provider on September 7, 2026 at 00:00 UTC, without requiring a version change. You can try the latest version in our[Console](https://console.unlayer.com/) .


-


Added host-managed AI Credit enforcement to the[Image Editor](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/image-editor/ai-assistant) , including runtime balance updates, while keeping non-AI image tools available when credits run out.


-


Added an opt-in AI Template Importer to the embedded AI Assistant, turning HTML and images into editable designs. Also improved Export Image performance and completeness for designs using asynchronous custom tools and external assets.


-


Improved[AI Credit reporting](https://docs.unlayer.com/server/cloud-api/ai-credits) by separating image edits from image generation and preserving end-user attribution across the Image Editor, Magic Image, and server-side AI endpoints.


## Bug Fixes


-


Preserved EXIF image orientation in sent emails, fixed built-in tool icon overrides in classic themes, and kept custom Body and Images tab icons consistent while active.


-


Fixed` setToolValidator` overrides being lost and ensured` excludeTools` applies to tools registered after initialization.


-


Fixed superscript text spacing in email mode on mobile browsers.


-


Fixed short[Link/Page dropdowns](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/link-management/link-types) truncating configured options, preserved Social icons in AI generated designs and custom configurations, and improved image and PDF export performance by eliminating duplicate font-request waits.


-


Updated the[AI Assistant](https://docs.unlayer.com/ai/assistant/how-it-works/content-protection) to respect template permissions in live mode, including during full-template rewrites. Locked content, such as compliance footers, stays unchanged and cannot be removed by AI. The Assistant still applies allowed edits and tells users when protected content was preserved.
